issue.title: [Validator] Fixes URL validation for single-char subdomains
issue.body:
| Q             | A
| ------------- | ---
| Branch?       | 4.4
| Bug fix?      | yes
| New feature?  | no
| Deprecations? | no
| Tickets       | Fix #43038
| License       | MIT
| Doc PR        | 

This fixes an issue with failing validations for valid URLs that have a single char in subdomains.

This bug was originally introduced on this commit: https://github.com/symfony/symfony/commit/074539d3c9b889f8b33b30d09633f86de1247c03

Some additional test cases with this scenario for valid and invalid URLs were added.
